itinerary.title: Explore Hanoi
description: Arrival in the capital sets a graceful tone: private welcome, smooth transfer, and an easy first evening that allows the family to settle in without pressure.
meals: Dinner at leisure; halal-friendly restaurant recommendations available.
activities: Private airport meet & greet, private transfer to hotel, assisted check-in, and a relaxed evening at leisure. Halal-friendly dinner guidance can be arranged on request.
notes: Sense of Pace: Relaxed and restorative

itinerary.title: Explore Hanoi / Ninh Binh
description: A full, elegant day of Northern Vietnam discovery, combining Hanoi’s cultural texture with Ninh Binh’s limestone scenery, in line with the proven Hanoi–Ninh Binh day structure used in the source programs  .
meals: Breakfast at hotel, lunch en route or locally arranged; dinner at leisure in Hanoi.
activities: Private guided sightseeing, Hanoi highlights, full-day Ninh Binh excursion, scenic boat experience at Trang An, entrance fees as applicable, and private return transfer.
notes: Sense of Pace: Immersive yet comfortable

itinerary.title: Explore Ha Long Bay
description: The journey becomes cinematic as the family transfers to Ha Long Bay and boards an overnight cruise, bringing the iconic limestone seascape into focus with calm, polished elegance.
meals: Breakfast, lunch, and dinner on the cruise; halal-friendly/seafood/vegetarian request to be advised in advance.
activities: Private transfer to the coast, overnight cruise accommodation, onboard meals, scenic cruising, and leisure time on deck with optional light activities subject to cruise program.
notes: Sense of Pace: Refined and scenic

itinerary.title: Explore Ha Long Bay / Hanoi
description: The final day unfolds gently with a tranquil morning on the bay, a leisurely brunch, and a smooth transfer back toward Hanoi for departure arrangements.
meals: Brunch on cruise; additional meals depend on flight timing.
activities: Brunch on board, cruise check-out, private transfer back to Hanoi or airport, and end-of-tour assistance.
notes: Sense of Pace: Unhurried and seamless
